title: zanthoxylum budrunga
intro: Zanthoxylum budrunga, commonly known as Indian pepper, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain, inflammation, and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents of Zanthoxylum budrunga include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, anti-ulcer, and antihypertensive effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant make it a potential natural remedy for various diseases, including arthritis, digestive disorders, and hypertension.
